title: A population pharmacokinetic-pharmacodynamic model of navtemadlin, its glucuronide metabolite (M1) and serum macrophage inhibitory cykokine-1 (MIC-1).
authors: Zhang, Lu; Poland, Bill; Green, Michelle; Wong, Shekman; Slatter, J Greg
journal: Xenobiotica; the fate of foreign compounds in biological systems
one_liner_zh: 该文研究药物navtemadlin及其代谢物的群体药代动力学/药效学模型，与蛋白质-DNA互作及TF-DNA结合机制完全无关。
abstract: Navtemadlin is a potent, selective, orally available inhibitor of murine double minute 2 that restores p53 activity to induce apoptosis in TP53 wild-type malignancies. Using richly sampled pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) data from healthy volunteers, a population PK/PD model was developed.A population PK (PPK) model described the PK characteristics of navtemadlin and its major metabolite acyl glucuronide (M1) and quantified enterohepatic recirculation (EHR). Post hoc individual PK parameters from this model were coupled with PD data for serum macrophage inhibitory cytokine-1 (MIC-1, GDF15), a cytokine biomarker of p53 activation, to construct a population PK/PD model that described plasma concentration-driven MIC-1 excursions and enabled simulation of the extent and duration of navtemadlin PD effects.The median apparent clearance (CL/F) and apparent central volume (V2/F) of navtemadlin were 36.4 L/hr and 159 L. The typical maximum stimulatory effect (S(max)) was close to the median maximum MIC-1 ratio to baseline of 7.29 in observed data.Simulation revealed a dose-dependent increase of MIC-1 with steady state attained in approximately 7 days, in a 7-day-on/21-day-off dose regimen. Elevated MIC-1 concentrations persist through 17-19 days, leaving about 9-11 PD-free days in a 28-day cycle.
abstract_zh: Navtemadlin是一种强效、选择性、口服可用的鼠双微体2抑制剂，可恢复p53活性以诱导TP53野生型恶性肿瘤中的细胞凋亡。利用来自健康志愿者的丰富采样的药代动力学（PK）和药效学（PD）数据，开发了一个群体PK/PD模型。群体PK（PPK）模型描述了navtemadlin及其主要代谢物酰基葡萄糖醛酸苷（M1）的PK特征，并量化了肠肝循环（EHR）。该模型的事后个体PK参数与血清巨噬细胞抑制因子-1（MIC-1，GDF15）的PD数据相结合，MIC-1是p53激活的细胞因子生物标志物，以构建一个群体PK/PD模型，该模型描述了血浆浓度驱动的MIC-1波动，并能够模拟navtemadlin PD效应的程度和持续时间。Navtemadlin的中位表观清除率（CL/F）和中位表观中央分布容积（V2/F）分别为36.4 L/hr和159 L。典型的最大刺激效应（S(max)）接近观察数据中MIC-1与基线比值的单位数最大值7.29。模拟显示，在7天给药/21天停药的剂量方案中，MIC-1呈剂量依赖性增加，约7天达到稳态。升高的MIC-1浓度持续17-19天，在28天周期中留下约9-11天无PD效应的时间。
